response.text: {"label": "protocol_misunderstanding", "reason": "The task sends data bits MSB first, which UART does not do, and it also sets each bit only after waiting a full bit period, so the intended A5 arrives as `389 3148000 rx hs 4a` instead of gold's `78 785000 rx hs a5`; no second 5a frame follows (gold `154 1545000 rx hs 5a`) and the run times out."}
